The '''Flower Garden Troupe''' is an all-female group of theater performers, which is managed by [[Ms. Chandler]]. They have a headquarters complex near [[Undella Town]] in [[Unova]], though they are often touring in their signature rose-decorated bus.

==Organization==
[[File:Flower Garden Troupe.png|thumb|250px|left|The Flower Garden Troupe during one of their theater shows]]
The Flower Garden Troupe is the most popular troupe in [[Unova]], and all of the performers are female, including the Pokémon. [[Moira]], [[Mona]], and [[Cher]] are the lead members. The Troupe likes to exemplify the qualities and etiquette of young and wealthy ladies, and as such, they often dress in regency-style garments.

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} clashed with the troupe in ''[[BW098|Beauties Battling for Pride and Prestige!]]''. They were put through several grueling tests of their patience and manners.
{{-}}
